spec.rule: A rejection extreme must occur at/after the actual six-second approach-origin quote, not in an earlier half of the twelve-second context. Preserve current breakout, tolerances, expiry lifecycle and bot. This was a prior isolated hypothesis with unresolved integration tests and is not assumed successful.
spec.development: All 15 previously inspected EURUSD windows; compare complete runtime streams, not retrospectively filtered baseline entries.
spec.source: Official Dukascopy EURUSD hourly BI5 tick archives; no interpolation; bid; actual last received tick at/before deadline.
spec.retuning: No parameter adjustment after inspecting these four validation windows.
spec.acceptance: Require aggregate validation win-rate improvement, positive aggregate illustrative fixed-stake net at 86% payout, no increase in worst validation-session loss streak and retain at least half baseline completed coverage. Also report every window, timing changes and failures. These criteria alone do not establish live OTC profitability or a statistically reliable advantage.
spec.unavailableData: Do not select replacement time windows based on results; report retrieval failures.
